children: WWW AI token launchpad reported an operating issue and a dispute over front-end private key exposure. According to Odaily, the official account said that during the restart of part of the backend, some browsers were intermittently offline.
All browsers are now back online, and Symbients are gradually resuming as browser sessions reconnect.

title: WWW AI Token Launchpad Reports Backend Restart Issue and Front-End Private Key Exposure Dispute
